verdict.rationale: dlt ships a large catalog of maintained/verified sources (REST APIs via declarative rest_api source + OpenAPI generator, SQL databases across many SQLAlchemy dialects, filesystem/cloud storage like S3/GCS/Azure/SFTP, plus 8000+ community connectors per llms.txt) and a broad set of destinations, with community corroboration (HN) praising ease of integration and connector breadth. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of connector maintenance quality/freshness across the full catalog and more third-party validation beyond one HN thread.
